components.name: Generate button
components.description: Full-width action with deepening hover and active states.
components.css: .ds-primary {font-family:var(--font-sans, "Hanken Grotesk", system-ui, sans-serif);display:flex;width:100%;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;min-height:54px;padding:14px 18px;border:0;border-radius:6px;background:var(--accent, #20564b);color:white;font-size:.9375rem;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;transition:background 180ms ease;} .ds-primary:hover:not(:disabled){background:var(--accent-hover, #153e35);} .ds-primary:active:not(:disabled){background:#0d3028;} .ds-primary:disabled{background:#49695f;cursor:not-allowed;} .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--focus, #956513); outline-offset:4px; } @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-primary{transition:none;}}

components.name: Download button
components.description: Bordered secondary action for a generated result.
components.html: <button class="ds-download"><svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.7" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M12 3v12m-5-5 5 5 5-5"/><path d="M4 16v5h16v-5"/></svg>Download image</button>
components.css: .ds-download{font-family:var(--font-sans, "Hanken Grotesk", system-ui, sans-serif);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;border:1px solid var(--control-border, #7c9184);background:var(--surface, #ffffff);color:var(--text, #183c36);border-radius:6px;padding:11px 14px;min-height:44px;font-size:.8125rem;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;transition:background 160ms ease;} .ds-download:hover:not(:disabled){background:var(--accent-soft, #d9e9e1);border-color:var(--accent, #20564b);} .ds-download:disabled{opacity:.5;cursor:not-allowed;} .ds-download:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--focus, #956513); outline-offset:4px; } @media(max-width:520px){.ds-download{width:100%;}} @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-download{transition:none;}}

components.name: Text action
components.html: <button class="ds-text">Try an example <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.7" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M4 12h16m-6-6 6 6-6 6"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-text{font-family:var(--font-sans, "Hanken Grotesk", system-ui, sans-serif);display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;background:none;border:0;color:var(--text, #183c36);font-size:.8125rem;font-weight:600;min-height:44px;text-decoration:underline;text-decoration-color:var(--border, #bdcbc4);text-underline-offset:5px;cursor:pointer;} .ds-text svg{width:16px;} .ds-text:hover:not(:disabled){text-decoration-color:currentColor;} .ds-text:disabled{opacity:.5;cursor:not-allowed;} .ds-text:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--focus, #956513); outline-offset:4px; }

components.name: Labeled field
components.description: Visible label and white text field with a strong focus boundary.
components.css: .ds-field{font-family:var(--font-sans, "Hanken Grotesk", system-ui, sans-serif);display:block;color:var(--text, #183c36);font-size:.875rem;font-weight:600;} .ds-field input{font-family:var(--font-sans, "Hanken Grotesk", system-ui, sans-serif);display:block;width:100%;margin-top:7px;background:var(--surface, #ffffff);border:1px solid var(--control-border, #7c9184);border-radius:6px;padding:12px 14px;font-size:1rem;font-weight:400;line-height:1.5;min-height:48px;color:var(--text, #183c36);caret-color:var(--accent, #20564b);transition:border-color 160ms ease;} .ds-field input::placeholder{color:#69776f;opacity:1;} .ds-field input:hover:not(:disabled){border-color:var(--text-muted, #566760);} .ds-field input:focus{border-color:var(--accent, #20564b);outline:2px solid var(--accent, #20564b);outline-offset:1px;} @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-field input{transition:none;}}

components.name: Style radio choice
components.description: Minimal Editorial type-study choice; native input controls selected and keyboard states.
components.css: .ds-choice{font-family:var(--font-sans, "Hanken Grotesk", system-ui, sans-serif);display:block;position:relative;width:140px;color:var(--text, #183c36);cursor:pointer;} .ds-choice input{position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;overflow:hidden;clip-path:inset(50%);} .ds-art{display:block;container-type:inline-size;aspect-ratio:1;overflow:hidden;border-radius:4px;background:var(--gallery, #e2e9e5);outline:2px solid transparent;outline-offset:3px;transition:outline-color 160ms ease;} .ds-study{display:block;height:100%;padding:14%;background:#f9faf6;color:#203c34;font-size:18cqw;line-height:.98;letter-spacing:-.04em;font-weight:750;} .ds-label{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:baseline;gap:4px;margin-top:12px;font-size:.8125rem;line-height:1.3;font-weight:650;} .ds-radio{width:13px;height:13px;flex:0 0 13px;border:1px solid var(--text-muted, #566760);border-radius:50%;align-self:center;} .ds-hint{display:block;margin-top:4px;color:var(--text-muted, #566760);font-size:.75rem;line-height:1.4;} .ds-choice:has(input:checked) .ds-art{outline-color:var(--accent, #20564b);} .ds-choice:has(input:checked) .ds-radio{border:4px solid var(--accent, #20564b);background:white;} .ds-choice:hover .ds-art{outline-color:var(--text-muted, #566760);} .ds-choice:has(input:focus-visible){outline:3px solid var(--focus, #956513);outline-offset:6px;border-radius:3px;} @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-art{transition:none;}}

narrative.overview:
Tonight gives colorful poster artwork room to lead inside a quiet, precise workspace. Cool mineral surfaces, deep teal text and actions, and compact grotesk typography make the controls feel familiar while the framed portrait provides the visual character.

This records implementation choices made within the authorized redesign. The palette and font are not exact choices prescribed by the user. Source evidence comes from `src/app/globals.css`, `src/app/layout.tsx`, and `src/components/poster-studio/PosterStudio.module.css` and `PosterStudio.tsx`. Rendered desktop and mobile verification remains outstanding because browser and native control were unavailable; these are extracted source rules, not screenshot-verified measurements.
keyCharacteristics: Cool mineral ground with a deep teal brand bar and primary action.
Hanken Grotesk throughout, with tight display tracking and readable form text.
Flat controls and a softly elevated portrait mount.
Clearly labeled artwork references and honest result, loading, and error states.

rules.name: The Artwork Color Rule
rules.body: Keep the surrounding workspace quiet so the poster can carry saturated color.

rules.name: The Paper Lift Rule
rules.body: Reserve the existing soft elevation for the poster mount; controls remain flat.

dos: **Do** keep the mineral workspace quiet around colorful artwork.
**Do** use visible labels, native form controls, and distinct keyboard focus.
**Do** distinguish sample artwork, type studies, generated results, and loading states.
**Do** preserve the last successful artwork while reporting a generation error.
**Do** honor reduced-motion preferences for loading and scroll behavior.
donts: **Don't** promote the artwork's colors or sample typography into application-wide tokens.
**Don't** add shadows to every control or round the portrait mount into a card.
**Don't** describe source-only responsive checks as rendered visual approval.
